AgentAccess.description: The most an agent of this profile may reach; the starting person's own permissions narrow it further at every call, and nothing here widens them (AG-70, MF-40).

endpoints.description: Endpoints the agent may read or write through.

kinds.description: Kinds the agent may read or propose changes to.

operations.description: Registry operation names (`jc_…`) the agent may call.

AgentEgress.description:
What one run may read from the internet, and how much of it (AG-50, AG-65).

The default is nothing: a profile that names no host reaches no host, and the workspace has no route of its own to fall back on (AG-34).

allowedHosts.description: Bare hostnames the package and fetch routes may reach; everything else is refused (AG-50).

maxBytesPerRun.description:
Bytes one run may read from those hosts in total, across every fetch (AG-65).

Absent means [`DEFAULT_EGRESS_BYTES_PER_RUN`]: reading documentation is what the allow-list is for, and a profile that had to name a number to get it would have every author guessing one. The cap is what stops a run from mirroring a site, not what stops it from reading a page.

AgentLimits.description: Computational, execution, and rate bounds per run (AG-41).

concurrentRunsPerOrganization.description: Runs one organization may have in flight at once.

maxResponseBytes.description: Bytes one proxied response may carry.

requestsPerMinute.description: Proxied requests per minute per run.

stepsPerRun.description: Agent steps one run may take before it stops and hands over the last log (AG-51).

maxTokensPerRun.description: Tokens one run may consume before the proxy ends it (AG-41).

provider.description: Which protocol the proxy speaks to the model provider.

reasoningEffort.description: How hard the model thinks on every call of a run; absent, no reasoning setting is sent (AG-72).

oneOf.description: Builder profile: coding tools in ephemeral workspace, egress allowlist.
Steward profile: MCP only, no internet egress.

access.description: What an agent of this profile may reach. Absent: read-only operations and nothing else (AG-70).

egress.description: Where the package route may go.

limits.description: The bounds every run of this profile is held to.

model.description: The model the proxy calls on the run's behalf.

role.description: What the profile is allowed to be used for (AG-26).

runtime.description: The runtime image a run of this profile executes.

tools.description: Tools the workspace carries; a steward profile carries none.

digest.description: Cryptographic container digest (`sha256:...`). Required for admission (AG-49).

oneOf.description: A shell in the ephemeral workspace.

cpu.description: CPU request and limit of the workspace container.

ephemeralStorage.description: Size of the `emptyDir` the workspace works in.

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

EndpointGrant.description: One endpoint an agent may reach, and how.

name.description: The endpoint's manifest name, a DNS-1123 label.

EndpointVerb.description: What an agent may do through an endpoint (AG-70).

oneOf.description: Read entities through the endpoint.
Write entities through the endpoint, under its policy.

KindGrant.description: One kind an agent may reach, and how.

kind.description: A manifest kind of the catalogue, e.g. `Endpoint`.

oneOf.description: Read manifests of the kind.
Propose a change to a manifest of the kind; a person still approves it.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.

Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

ReasoningEffort.description: The provider's reasoning setting a run's model calls carry (AG-72).

oneOf.description: A short think before each answer.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.
